scope: API-compatibility shim layer (:core:extension-api) so third-party extension DEXes link in the in-process DexClassLoader runtime. Evidence-based: every shim FQCN/signature derives from dexdump of the three fixture-pinned extension APKs.

inventory.method: tools/inventory.py (checked-in, stdlib-only) parses the committed keiyoushi-index.pb fixture, downloads the pinned APKs, extracts classes*.dex, and derives referenced-type/member sets via dexdump -f -d plus direct DEX header parsing.
inventory.referenceAbi: keiyoushi/extensions-lib v1.6 commit 42255ee5fa (tachiyomi-lib-v16); Mihon source-api for runtime behaviors (generateId, headersBuilder, setUrlWithoutDomain, model impl defaults)
inventory.tempDir: C:\Users\paele\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\extdex\ (APKs, extracted dex, full dexdump texts, upstream reference sources - kept for later agents)

shimModule.type: Android library, namespace com.yomira.core.extension.api, classes under eu.kanade.tachiyomi.* for link compatibility
keyFacts: Source/HttpSource expose the v1.6 suspend API only (getPopularManga/getLatestUpdates/getSearchManga/getMangaUpdate/getPageList); callback-style getMangaDetails/getChapterList/getImageList verified NOT required by the audited DEXes
Model constructor defaults pinned by DEX $default synthetics replicated exactly (Filter.CheckBox/Select/Separator/Text/TriState, Page incl. android.net.Uri)

NetworkHelper.client/OkHttpExtensionsKt.await+awaitSuccess/RequestsKt.GET$default implemented for real; OkHttpClient comes from eu.kanade.tachiyomi.shim.ShimServiceLocator.configure(client, userAgent?) - host injects its instrumented client; unconfigured access fails fast with ShimNotSupportedException naming the member

Mihon behaviors mirrored: generateId (MD5 name/lang/versionId big-endian, sign bit cleared), default UA headersBuilder, imageRequest, setUrlWithoutDomain (URI-decoded), SMangaImpl/SChapterImpl defaults
consumer-rules.pro keeps eu.kanade.tachiyomi.** unrenamed through release minification; classes verified present in app-debug.apk dex

knownMissing: JavaScriptEngine.evaluate - shipped for ABI completeness, always throws ShimNotSupportedException naming the member; needs a JS engine (QuickJS) to become functional; not referenced by the audited DEXes

parseJsoup/parseAs/parseAsJsoupList/parseAsSrcDocstring/parseAsProtoBytes, JavaNetClient, eu.kanade.tachiyomi.util.* - verified NOT referenced by the three audited DEXes (they call jsoup/kotlinx-serialization directly); add shims only if a future extension requires them
hostRequirementsForRuntimeAgent: See .orchestrator/execution/runtime-link-inventory.md (HOST-PROVIDED table): jsoup, injekt-core (JitPack repo needed), okhttp 5.4.0 upgrade (Gzip/zstd/CompressionInterceptor/maxAge-LRDsOJo members), okhttp-brotli, okhttp-zstd + zstd-kmp-okio, kotlinx-serialization-json-okio, androidx.preference, coroutines 1.11.0 (runBlockingK$default, Job.cancel$default), kotlin-stdlib 2.4.x (Instant$Companion.parseOrNull).

tests.inventoryRegression: InventoryLinkContractTest - required eu.kanade.* sets, referenced members, overridden source virtuals (from checked-in text inventory, not binaries) all resolve on the shim classpath; external members resolve unless documented host-provided
tests.reflectionAndBehavior: ShimBehaviorContractTest incl. FakeSource synthetic mini-extension compiled against the shim; Mihon id algorithm; filter/model shapes; setUrlWithoutDomain; GET/POST; await/awaitSuccess via MockWebServer
tests.injection: ServiceLocatorInjectionTest - fail-fast before injection, injected client used by NetworkHelper/FakeSource, userAgent override, reset

gateTails: .\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug: BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 40s, 288 actionable tasks: 32 executed, 2 from cache, 254 up-to-date
goSignal: Go for runtime host implementation: load DEXes with a DexClassLoader whose parent exposes this module, call ShimServiceLocator.configure(instrumentedClient) before first use, and satisfy the HOST-PROVIDED table (okhttp 5.4.0, coroutines 1.11.0, stdlib 2.4.x, jsoup, injekt via JitPack, brotli/zstd, json-okio) before enabling real sources.
knownLimits: Shims make DEXes link and model/network code run; no security boundary is added - in-process extensions still run with the host app's permissions (documented product decision).
Only the three fixture-pinned extensions are audited; other extensions may reference additional members (InventoryLinkContractTest will surface them if their inventories are added).
JavaScriptEngine.evaluate and the util/parse* surface are unimplemented (see knownMissing); no automated device or install verification was in scope.
